profile_text.body:
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited describes itself as the world's dedicated semiconductor foundry since 1987. According to its site, it supports an ecosystem of global customers and partners with process technology and a portfolio of design enablement solutions, and it says its business model accelerates innovation in integrated circuit design and product applications. The company also states that it contributes to global IC innovation and to Taiwan's economy.

The company is a public company headquartered in Hsinchu, trading under the ticker TSM. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001046179. No AI-specific products, MCP servers, or lawsuits appear in the records held on the company.
